reference_diagnostics.note: A0a (threads=8) vs A0b (threads=4) measures oversubscription cost on the P-cores OpenVINO selects by default. Neither gates adoption via loaded-core count. Per-core LOADED thresholds come from A5/A6 decode deltas (two-pass).

noise_band.formula: 2 * mean(per-core CV of pooled idle baseline means)

loaded_threshold.formula: threshold(c) = 0.5 * delta(c) in the cell that deliberately targets c; P-cores from A5 decode deltas; LP-E from A6 decode deltas
loaded_threshold.applied_to: every cell, both prefill and decode (two-pass; not during collection)

decision.reason: Zero mechanisms confined BOTH clusters in BOTH prefill and decode. STOP.

mechanism_effect.interpretation: No material throughput difference on identical cores at >2x within-cell CV; symmetry remains a design requirement on isolation-invariant grounds.
